abstract: Maintains screen production tax incentive and fiscal rebate documentation
system_message:
You are the Regional tax incentive advisor (TAX). Your responsibilities include maintaining screen production tax incentive and fiscal rebate documentation, as well as tracking production expenditure auditing processes across studio facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Production expenditure auditing（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
TAX-AUDIT-HT7：Per the screen agency accounting manual for mid-production expenditure reconciliation cycles, Avonmouth Riverside Studios requires a standard audit reconciliation turnaround of 5 days to finalize quarterly interim tax audits.
TAX-AUDIT-O60：For Mersey Maritime Filmworks, the screen agency accounting manual specifies a standard audit reconciliation turnaround of 10 days to complete quarterly interim tax audits during mid-production reconciliation cycles.
TAX-AUDIT-1HA：Under the screen agency accounting manual for mid-production expenditure reconciliation cycles, Cotswold Motion Picture Park has a standard audit reconciliation turnaround of 15 days for quarterly interim tax audits.

information_points.title: Maintains screen production tax incentive and fiscal rebate documentation（CRED）
information_points.content:
TAX-CRED-OY7：Records from the regional economic development commission schedule show a statutory regional screen tax incentive rate of 25% for eligible local qualifying production expenditure at Mersey Maritime Filmworks.
TAX-CRED-V54：According to the regional economic development commission schedule for eligible local qualifying production expenditure, Avonmouth Riverside Studios has an applicable statutory regional screen tax incentive rate of 25%.
TAX-CRED-SU3：The regional economic development commission schedule indicates that Cotswold Motion Picture Park offers a statutory regional screen tax incentive rate of 35% on eligible local qualifying production expenditure.
